messages:
anna: Heads up — partner (APAC cloud marketplace) flagged duplicate charges for the same billing window. Seeing a handful of customers with 2x usage for the same hour. Anyone else seeing this pattern? :thinking:

ben: I saw a couple of alerts earlier. Are these duplicates from retries or distinct events?

anna: Looks like retries + new event ids. Partner retries push new `usage_id` every attempt. Their platform TTL for usage confirmation is different across regions — APAC delayed confirmations trigger our backfill which re-ingests the same usage but with a different id.

miguel: We currently dedupe on `usage_id` only. If partner sends new ids we don't catch it. We should build a composite idempotency key on our side.

ben: Agreed. Proposal: generate dedupe key = `customer_id|metering_id|window_start|hash(quantity+meter_unit)`. That way small noise in quantity won't match unless actually different.

anna: That sounds reasonable. Need to be careful with rounding differences between partner and us (they report to 3 decimals). Maybe normalize with rounding to 2 decimals.

sophie: Can you paste a redacted example payload so I can loop in @partners-team? Also want to check if credits/coupons are being applied differently which might mask the issue.

marketplace-bot: webhook_deliver_failed: { url: https://hooks.redwood.example/partner-usage, status: 502, retries: 3, last_attempt: 2026-09-02T03:12:07Z }

anna: Example payload (redacted):
{ "usage_id": "u_20260902_123456_1", "customer_id": "acct_XXXX", "metering_id": "tokens_generated", "quantity": 124.732, "unit": "tokens", "window_start": "2026-09-02T02:00:00Z", "window_end": "2026-09-02T03:00:00Z", "region": "ap-southeast-2", "partner_event_id": "evt_xyz_abc", "received_at": "2026-09-02T03:15:22Z" }

ben: If partner_event_id is stable across retries we can use that, but you said they generate new ids. If so the composite key approach is safer.

miguel: Implementation notes: - Backfill dedupe: run a reconciliation job for last 14 days using composite key. - Live ingestion: compute composite key at ingestion path and check fast dedupe store (redis TTL 30d). - Flag rollout: enable behind `partners.dedupe_composite` feature flag for suspect partners first.

anna: Important: credits. APAC partner sometimes issues post-hoc credits that we ingest as negative usage. If dedupe removes original event we might also lose corresponding credit pairing. Need to ensure reconciliation links credits to original composite keys.

sophie: Good catch. Let's include `credit_reference` when available and model pairing as: original_key <-> credit_reference. If we prune original, keep a tombstone record referencing credit so finance can reconcile.

ben: I'll prototype the composite key generation in a lambda and share unit tests. Target: patch ingestion within 48h.

miguel: I'll scope the backfill job and estimate cost. If we do 30d full-reconcile it will touch ~1.2M records, estimate 6h run on batch workers.

anna: Action items: - ben: prototype composite dedupe + unit tests (owner) - miguel: reconciliation job spec + cost estimate (owner) - sophie: collect 3 anonymized payload examples and open partner ticket + schedule sync (owner) - ops: enable `partners.dedupe_composite` flag for APAC pilot (pending infra)

sophie: tagging @eng-infra and @finance. Can someone from finance confirm whether tombstones will be acceptable for billing audit?

marketplace-bot: scheduled_run: reconciliation_job_apac_preview queued at 2026-09-02T04:00:00Z

anna: Thanks — will consolidate notes and create a short incident-lite doc for partner. We'll keep thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
